description: Paid ($0.05 via x402 in USDC on Base, Solana, Algorand or Stellar, or in RLUSD on the XRP Ledger): diagnoses your x402 endpoint, then returns per problem the concrete change as code for your stack (express, next, hono, node, python, generic), filled in with your own payTo, amount, network and route. A working endpoint gets improvements too (ERC-8004 identity, Base Builder Code, x402scan ownership proof, skill.md, browser paywall, Bazaar output schema), each with code. For the endpoint's owner: includes the diagnosis, so there is no need to call x402_diagnose first. Same as GET /api/v1/fix. The answer carries a signed receipt (EIP-191, bound to your arguments) that proves later which verdict you got.

body.description: Example JSON request body, for a POST route that checks its input before the 402 (implies POST). Without it, {} is sent and the requestBody example in the endpoint's /openapi.json is tried.

method.description: HTTP method of the paid route (default: GET, then POST)

url.description: The x402 endpoint (public http(s) URL), e.g. https://api.example.com/paid

name: x402_fix

accepts.description: Only on an unpaid call: the x402 payment options

fixes.description: Each problem with steps and code for your stack

improvements.description: Not wrong, but makes the service easier to find, trust or pay: steps and code

receipt.description: Signed receipt (EIP-191) binding the answer to your arguments

title: Fix plan for an x402 endpoint ($0.05 via x402)
